incident-bot: INCIDENT 1803456789 — Streaming tail latency spike on /v1/stream (SSE + WS). Auto-paging oncall. Severity: potentially impacting p99 SLOs. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/streaming/alerts. Initial alert at 01:46 UTC.
elena (oncall-sre): I'm on it — seeing many stalled streams with long gaps between chunks (>5s). p95 went from ~230ms -> ~4.2s, p99 ~12s right now. Error rate for streaming route up 3x.
max (oncall-sre): acked. Any proxy errors in the logs?
elena (oncall-sre): yes, gate-proxy shows repeated upstream timeouts and short bursts of ECONNRESET/writev EAGAIN. Looks like backpressure at proxy -> upstream path. Sample logs: 
```
2026-03-14T01:46:12Z gate-proxy[pid:223]: upstream timed out (110) while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.2.3.45, server: api, request: \"GET /v1/stream?session=xx\", upstream: \"http://10.4.5.6:8080/\", host: \"api.redwood.com\"
2026-03-14T01:46:13Z runtime[pid:987]: chunk flush delayed: last_flush=5100ms, pending_kv=0
2026-03-14T01:46:14Z gate-proxy[pid:223]: writev failed (EAGAIN) while sending to client, client: 10.2.3.45
```
david (infra): On the proxy side I'm seeing worker saturation and accept queue growth. kernel: somaxconn near limit, proxies spinning on write. Might be client-side not reading, filling socket buffers -> backpressure to upstream.
maya (prod-eng): We have recent client incidents where Node SDKs don't drain streams fast (older http2 agent build). Could be a client churn with many idle reads. I can check top client user agents.
elena (oncall-sre): Quick mitigation plan: 1) increase gate-proxy worker_count + somaxconn temporarily 2) reduce chunk flush interval to force smaller frequent chunks (100ms) 3) widen proxy upstream timeout to 30s as temporary 4) enable streaming_fallback_poll toggle for 10% traffic to reduce KB cache pressure 5) notify CS for top customers and enable polling fallback for them if needed. Applying step 1+2 now.
david (infra): applying kernel tunables now: `sysctl -w net.core.somaxconn=1024` and bumping proxy replicas.
max (oncall-sre): elena — can you share the kubectl patch you used for the chunking interval? I'll take handoff in 10m.
elena (oncall-sre): patch I used: 
```bash
kubectl -n runtime patch configmap runtime-streaming-config -p '{"data":{"chunk_flush_ms":"100"}}'
# then rollout restart deploy/runtime-service
```
Tested with curl stream and saw chunk gaps drop to <120ms.
```bash
curl -N -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream?test=flush' | ts
# observed continuous chunks every ~100ms
```
max (oncall-sre): good. I've increased gate-proxy replicas from 3 -> 6 and bumped timeouts to 30s as stop-gap. Monitoring queue length.
maya (prod-eng): rolling back Node http2 agent to patched build? If clients still misbehaving we should enable small-chunk heartbeats server-side to keep sockets alive and prompt client reads. Can enable as feature flag.
jordan-cs: any idea which customers are impacted? need to triage support tickets.
elena (oncall-sre): preliminary count: ~18k streaming sessions affected in last 15m, ~7 customers show >5% of their sessions slow (customers: beta-app, internal-labs, acme-int). Customer impact window ~01:44-02:04 UTC and decreasing after mitigations.
max (oncall-sre): taking over oncall. Handoff: mitigations applied (chunk_flush_ms=100, gate-proxy x2 replicas, somaxconn=1024, proxy timeout=30s, streaming_fallback_poll=10%). Monitoring: p95 -> 360ms, p99 -> 2.1s and trending down. I'll keep watch for 60m. If p99 > 5s again we escalate to SEV1.
david (infra): added a temporary iptables rule to drop unruly clients after 120s of no read to relieve proxy. We'll remove once stable.
maya (prod-eng): opened small-toggle to enable per-client polling fallback and heartbeat for highest affected customers. Requesting product approval to flip for acme-int and beta-app.
jordan-cs: acknowledged. I'll update customer tickets — reporting mitigation in progress and ETA for full resolution ~+1h.
elena (oncall-sre): follow-ups: collect tcpdump on gate-proxy for one hour, save runtime heap/threads for 15min window, tag logs with incident id 1803456789. Postmortem owner: max.
max (oncall-sre): assigning postmortem, will own timeline + RCA. Action items: 1) add per-route small-chunk heartbeat fallback 2) improve proxy backpressure metrics (socket write queue) 3) add client SDK guideline re: streaming drain and example 4) add automated canary that exercises chunking at scale.
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1803456789 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Impact: degraded streaming tail latency for ~20m; mitigations applied; follow-up required.
jordan-cs: thanks team — I'll send a brief customer update and flag enterprise customers for a technical follow-up call. :thumbsup:
max (oncall-sre): will post a summary in #incidents when I open the postmortem. Closing active paging for now; re-open if regressions.
